summary: The Unicode character-class printer renders [-./] as (?u:[--/]), which reparses without the dot and changes matching behavior. The fix prints the hyphen separately at the beginning and adjusts the remaining range, producing (?u:[-\.-/]). This reversal isolates the Unicode implementation change. The selected regression test was added by the fix in regex-syntax/src/lib.rs; its first assertion detects this formatting error. No tests were run.
